about_short_description.short_description: Causaly develops a biomedical research discovery tool designed to find and unlock key hidden evidence in biomedicine.

product.name: Causaly Platform
product.description: An enterprise AI workspace for life sciences R&D that combines biomedical evidence retrieval, scientific reasoning, knowledge-graph exploration, commercial intelligence, and private-data integration.

product.name: Scientific Workflows
product.description: A workflow automation product that converts expert life sciences research methods into repeatable, AI-executed processes for evidence-based R&D decisions.

product.name: Agentic Research
product.description: A science-focused AI research environment in which specialized agents plan, search, analyze, and synthesize biomedical evidence for R&D questions.

product.name: Bio Graph
product.description: A visual biomedical knowledge exploration tool that maps cause-and-effect relationships among targets, genes, pathways, diseases, drugs, biomarkers, and mechanisms.

product.name: Pipeline Graph
product.description: A commercial and scientific intelligence tool for comparing drug programs, assets, competitors, and development pipelines alongside biological evidence.

product.name: Discover
product.description: A research discovery environment that helps life sciences teams search biomedical information, extract relevant insights, and investigate evidence at scale.
